name: narrate
description: Narrate — free, private text-to-speech for any page. Highlight text, hit play.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../narrate.zip . -x '.*'
